summary: Frontend-only testing of new device-locale-based first-run language auto-detection feature (expo-localization) in AdminSettingsContext.tsx. All 5 requested test scenarios executed via Playwright with isolated browser contexts (locale='da-DK' / 'en-US') against the live Expo web preview at localhost:3000, verifying backend persistence via GET localhost:8001/api/admin/settings. Feature works correctly end-to-end.
action_items: None required. Consider adding testID props directly to Tabs.Screen (tabBarTestID does not render as data-testid on web via react-navigation bottom tabs) if future automated tab-navigation testing via testID selectors is needed - text-based selectors were used instead as a workaround.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminSettingsContext.tsx detectDeviceLanguage() + refresh() logic is correct: null/unset language -> auto-detect from navigator locale via expo-localization and PUT to persist once; explicit 'en'/'da' already stored -> always respected regardless of current device locale. Verified via direct network request interception that PUT with {"language":"da"} or {"language":"en"} fires ONLY when data.language was null, and never fires when an explicit value is already present.

IMPORTANT TESTING GOTCHA (for future test agents, not a real app bug): the mcp_browser_automation tool auto-loads the given page_url into the default `page` BEFORE the script body executes. If the app's language is null at that moment, this default page (with the test-harness's own default browser locale, not necessarily Danish) will independently trigger its own GET->detect->PUT cycle and persist a language value milliseconds into the test, silently contaminating any 'fresh install' test that tries to use a separately-created browser context with a different locale. Initial testing incorrectly flagged this as a bug (Danish locale not detected). Root-caused by re-running with page_url='about:blank' to prevent the default page from auto-loading the app, which confirmed the feature works exactly as specified. Recommendation: always use page_url='about:blank' when testing 'null language / fresh install' scenarios for this feature.

Manual language switching in Admin -> Sprog & enheder (admin-language-da/en testIDs + admin-lang-save-button) correctly persists and is respected on next reload/navigation - full regression pass, no issues.

success_rate.backend: N/A - not tested per instructions (one-line model default change already verified manually)

seed_data_creation: None. Reset/unset backend app_settings.language field twice via direct python3/database.py script (as instructed) to simulate fresh installs between test scenarios. Final state left as language='da' (explicit, non-null) per instructions - a result of Test 4's manual switch, so it is not left unset.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Feature fully verified: Test 1 (da-DK fresh install -> detects+persists 'da', shows 'Dagsoversigt'/'Agamer') PASS. Test 2 (en-US locale but saved 'da' pref -> still shows Danish, no PUT re-fired) PASS. Test 3 (en-US fresh install -> detects+persists 'en', shows 'Overview'/'Dragons') PASS. Test 4 (manual switch to Danish via Admin -> Sprog & enheder, persists across reload) PASS. Test 5 (all 5 tabs navigate correctly, zero console errors related to expo-localization or otherwise) PASS. Backend app_settings.language left as 'da' at end of session (explicit, not null).
rca_of_issue: No real bug found. Initial false-positive (Danish locale defaulting to English) was a test-harness artifact: the browser_automation tool's auto-loaded default `page` (using its own default locale, distinct from the intentionally-created da-DK browser context) raced ahead and persisted 'en' to the backend before the Danish-locale test context ever loaded, because the language field was null at test start. Using page_url='about:blank' to prevent this auto-load eliminated the race and confirmed correct behavior in all scenarios.
